mentions.name: urhired.ai
mentions.description: This platform runs AI-powered mock technical interviews covering system design and coding, with behavioral mock interviews and a coach feature in development. It offers on-demand practice in a judgment-free environment where candidates can fail as much as they need and learn.
mentions.problem: Interview prep is hard to do on demand and people fear judgment, so a safe environment to fail repeatedly helps them actually learn.
mentions.audience: Prep tool framed for technical interview candidates, free to try while it is early
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on https://urhired.ai

It’s an AI-powered mock technical interviewing platform, for system design and coding.
mentions.author: skreem
